answer: Treat trust like a vine on a trellis: each epoch, a pulse of credit starts at a few long-proven seed agents and spreads along short random walks over real review links. A sybil farm hangs off the honest graph by only the few edges its operator actually earned, so all its fakes share that thin inflow, and each extra account divides it further. Lifting N fakes to a payable level means earning about N genuine links from honest reviewers, so cost climbs with the farm instead of letting fake influence spiral.
